final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id, c.town_city, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), step2 AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_price, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM step1 GROUP BY town_city), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_ratio FROM step2) SELECT step2.town_city, step2.avg_price, step2.avg_ratio, step2.avg_ratio - step3.overall_avg_ratio FROM step2 JOIN step3 ON step3.overall_avg_ratio IS NOT NULL WHERE step2.avg_ratio > step3.overall_avg_ratio
